To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) one can solve the Poisson equation on irregular domains using a combination of the level-set method, the ghost fluid method and the quadtree/octree mesh refinement method, (ii) one can solve the diffusion equation on irregular domains by combining the level-set method and the octree mesh refinement method and (iii) one can solve Stefan problem by combining the levelset method, the ghost-fluid method and the quadree/octree mesh refinement methods.
the level-set/ghost-fluid methods and the quadtree/octree adaptive mesh refinement methods are very efficient for solving the Stefan, Poisson and diffusion problems in complex geometries.

(i) one can solve the Stefan problem and Poisson and diffusion equations on arbitrary geometries with high resolution, (ii) solving the diffusion equation with a high resolution method on an irregular domain is not trivial, and (iii) solving the Poisson equation on an irregular domain using the ghost-fluid method is not as simple as solving it using the boundary-element method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the numerical solution of partial differential equations on complex geometries.
developing high resolution sharp computational methods for the solution of the Stefan problem and Poisson and diffusion equations on irregular geometries.
the design and implementation of efficient, high-resolution, and robust numerical methods for solving elliptic and parabolic partial differential equations in irregular domains.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, if the domain is irregular but fixed, the level-set method is the most appropriate method for representing the domain.

the level-set, ghost-fluid and adaptive mesh refinement methods are very robust, easy-to-implement and highly accurate numerical methods that are capable of solving a wide variety of challenging and important problems.

the level-set method, the ghost-fluid method and the quadtree/octree node based adaptive mesh refinement are very effective and efficient numerical tools for solving the Stefan, Poisson and the heat diffusion equations on irregularly shaped domains.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed and implemented state-of-the-art high resolution sharp numerical methods for the Stefan problem and for solving Poisson and diffusion equations on irregular geometries.

we have shown that it is possible to obtain very accurate results for the Stefan problem and for the Poisson and diffusion equations in complex geometries using the level-set method, the ghost-fluid method and the quadtree/octree node based AMR.
we have developed a high-resolution sharp computational method for elliptic and parabolic problems in complex geometries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, when using these high-resolution sharp computational methods, the irregularity of the domain does not have to be an impediment to obtaining accurate and robust numerical solutions.

, by using a combination of the aforementioned methods, it is possible to obtain accurate numerical solutions for the Stefan, Poisson and diffusion problems on irregular domains at a fraction of the cost and computational resources compared to traditional approaches.
these methods can be used to solve the aforementioned problems on irregular domains at a fraction of the cost of traditional methods, while achieving similar accuracy.
